title: GTA 6 PEGI 18 Rating Reveals Decapitation, Cocaine, and More
description: GTA 6 has received a PEGI 18 rating, revealing new details including decapitation, the ability to snort cocaine anytime, and sexual fetish scenes.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 PEGI 18 Rating Details Unveiled

As anticipation builds for one of the most awaited releases in gaming history, new details regarding Grand Theft Auto 6 have emerged. According to a report by IGN Games, GTA 6 has officially received a PEGI 18 age rating, which has inadvertently brought to light several striking details regarding the game's mature content.

### What the Rating Reveals

Rockstar Games has never shied away from pushing boundaries in open-world crime simulations, but the specific mentions in the PEGI 18 rating suggest that GTA 6 will dive even deeper into mature themes. The reported rating details include:

*   **Extreme Violence:** The rating document explicitly mentions "decapitation," hinting at brutal visual feedback during combat or execution sequences.
*   **Substance Use:** Players will apparently have the ability to snort cocaine at any time, integrating drug use directly into the moment-to-moment gameplay mechanics with high freedom.
*   **Adult Themes:** The inclusion of "scenes of sexual fetishes" points to provocative narrative and interactive elements exploring controversial subjects.

### Context and Expectations

While an 18+ rating comes as no surprise for the franchise, the specific inclusion of these unvarnished gameplay elements highlights Rockstar's commitment to portraying a raw, unfiltered criminal underworld. This approach is bound to spark traditional debates regarding media censorship and mature gaming content, while simultaneously satisfying fans who expect an uncompromising vision.

### Editor's Take

The PEGI 18 rating details for GTA 6 prove that Rockstar Games is doubling down on its gritty, unfiltered realism. Mechanics like constant cocaine access and decapitation push the boundaries of open-world gameplay, ensuring the title remains strictly for mature audiences.
